title: Glow and Sculpt Face Serum Primer with Niacinamide

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, antioxidants, siliconeFree, parabenFree, fragranceFree, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ Good for: Redness✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Radiant Finish✓ Niacinamide

What it is: A hydrating priming serum with a facial roller to sculpt your face and leave a healthy, radiant glow.


Finish: Radiant


Skin Type: Normal, Oily, Dry, and Combination


Concerns: Dryness and Redness


Highlighted Ingredients:

- Niacinamide: Helps to visibly brighten skin and reduce the appearance of redness and blemishes.

- Glycerin: Helps to leave the skin feeling hydrated.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-For best results, apply after moisturizing and before applying makeup.
-Gently squeeze the tube so the formula comes out onto the roller applicator.
-Massage the roller over the skin, working outward toward the edges of the face.
-For hygiene reasons, REFY recommends wiping the roller after every use.
-For best results, store the product at room temperature and do not refrigerate.

Recycling Instructions:
-Remove the roller head.
-Cut along the top of the tube and rinse to ensure there is no product left.
-The tube and lid can both be recycled in your home recycling bin.
-The roller is made of PE and TPE and should be recyclable at your local recycling bank.
Ingredients+
-Niacinamide: Helps to visibly brighten skin and reduce the appearance of redness and blemishes.
-Glycerin: Helps to leave the skin feeling hydrated.

Aqua/Water/Eau, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Glycereth-26, 1,2-Hexanediol, Niacinamide, Camellia Sinensis Seed Oil, Methylpropanediol, Panthenol, Chlorella Vulgaris Extract, Glucose, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Fructooligosaccharides, Fructose, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Sodium Polyacryloyldimethyl Taurate, Yeast Ferment Extract, Tromethamine, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Sodium Phytate, Candida Bombicola/Glucose/Methyl Rapeseedate Ferment, Tocopherol.
